The '''Lamont Dynasty of Daimar''', also known as the '''Royal House of Daimar''', was the ruling family of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The royal house was led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] and was well liked by the people of Daimar.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
